mapper.select: SELECT sh.sh_id AS shId, sh.hw_id AS hwId, h.c_id AS cId, h.title AS title, h.content AS content, h.total_score AS totalScore, sh.stu_id AS stuId, u.real_name AS studentName, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.class_name AS className, DATE_FORMAT(sh.submit_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS submitTime, sh.answers AS answers, sh.score AS score, sh.teacher_comment AS comment, sh.status AS status FROM my_student_homework sh INNER JOIN my_homework h ON h.hw_id = sh.hw_id INNER JOIN my_student s ON s.stu_id = sh.stu_id INNER JOIN my_sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE sh.sh_id = #{shId}
